headline: Revenue grows but profitability swings sharply negative
summary_short: Revenue rose 2.0% y/y to $1,081.5M and gross profit rose 6.3% to $735.4M, but net income swung to a $(77.9)M loss from $98.3M a year ago and diluted EPS fell to $(0.40) from $0.49.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,081.5M, up 2.0% y/y. Gross profit rose 6.3% y/y to $735.4M. Operating income fell to $(31.0)M from $175.7M y/y; EBIT fell to $(27.5)M from $168.7M y/y. EBITDA declined 74.0% y/y to $67.9M. Net income swung to a $(77.9)M loss from $98.3M net income a year ago. Diluted and basic EPS were both $(0.40) versus $0.49 y/y, down 181.6%.
